\section{\texttt{build\_telemetry}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.factory.build_telemetry}\index{Functions!build\_telemetry}

Construct the telemetry emitter configured by the settings.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
build_telemetry(settings: Settings) -> Telemetry
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{settings}] \texttt{Settings}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{Telemetry}
\apifield{Details}Telemetry is disabled (a no-op emitter) unless \texttt{FEEDBACK\_\allowbreak{}AGENT\_\allowbreak{}TELEMETRY\_\allowbreak{}ENABLED} is set. The default enabled backend appends events to the JSONL file configured by \texttt{FEEDBACK\_\allowbreak{}AGENT\_\allowbreak{}TELEMETRY\_\allowbreak{}PATH}; \texttt{opentelemetry} emits spans through the process-global OpenTelemetry tracer provider.
